name: 75057 · Lewisville, TX
findings: ZIP 75057 (Lewisville) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75057 (Lewisville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75057 (Lewisville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.
